request.name: Boney Kapoor
request.title: Producer, Director
request.about:
Achal Surinder "Boney" Kapoor (born 11 November 1955) is an Indian film producer primarily associated with Hindi cinema, in addition to Tamil and Telugu cinema.

Kapoor was born as Achal Surinder Kapoor in 1955, the son of Surinder Kapoor who was a Bollywood film producer, and Nirmal Kapoor. Born into a Punjabi Hindu family, he had an Arya Samaji upbringing. His younger brothers Anil and Sanjay are both actors and producers.

Kapoor was married to Mona Shourie from 1983 to 1996 and the couple has two children, Arjun Kapoor (born 1985) and Anshula (born in 1990). Arjun made his acting debut in the 2012 movie Ishaqzaade while Anshula graduated from Barnard College.

Kapoor married Indian actress Sridevi on 2 June 1996. The couple had two daughters, Janhvi Kapoor (born 6 March 1997) and Khushi Kapoor (born 5 November 2000). On 24 February 2018, Sridevi died in Dubai after drowning in her hotel bathtub. The Kapoor family of Prithviraj Kapoor are also his distant relatives as Prithviraj was Surinder's cousin.

events.event: The Bombay High Court ruled that Boney Kapoor was not liable to pay interest on a disputed Rs 31 lakh deposit linked to a 2001 financial fraud case under the MPID Act involving another accused.

Addressed allegations made by a camera equipment vendor who filed a civil suit and sought to block the release of the film 'Maidaan' over nearly Rs 1 crore in unpaid dues, with Kapoor dismissing it as an 'arm-twisting tactic'.
The Rajasthan High Court quashed an FIR of cheating and duping (worth Rs 2.5 crores regarding a Celebrity Cricket League investment) that had been filed against Boney Kapoor.

Faced intense public scrutiny, media speculation, and conspiracy theories following the sudden tragic death of his wife, legendary actress Sridevi, in a Dubai hotel bathtub (which authorities later ruled an accidental drowning).

His name surfaced in an Economic Offences Wing (EOW) probe regarding luxury vehicle tax evasion, after his imported Toyota Land Cruiser was found to have a tampered chassis number and fraudulent documentation.
Faced significant media controversy and moral policing following his separation from his first wife, Mona Shourie, and his subsequent relationship and marriage to actress Sridevi.
